formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 → (∀ x3 ∈ [(3 : ℕ), (6 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ), (17 : ℕ), (24 : ℕ), (33 : ℕ), (66 : ℕ), (132 : ℕ), (160 : ℕ), (264 : ℕ), (288 : ℕ), (320 : ℕ)], x1.eval ((List.ofFn fun (x5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) => x3.testBit ↑x5) ++ [x3.testBit (0 : ℕ) || x3.testBit (1 : ℕ)]) = Bool.true) → (∀ x4 ∈ [(42 : ℕ), (50 : ℕ), (69 : ℕ), (104 : ℕ), (116 : ℕ), (138 : ℕ), (201 : ℕ), (208 : ℕ), (261 : ℕ), (276 : ℕ), (385 : ℕ), (402 : ℕ)], x1.eval ((List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) => x4.testBit ↑x6) ++ [x4.testBit (0 : ℕ) || x4.testBit (1 : ℕ)]) = Bool.false) → (15 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size
plain_statement: Petersen graph minus a vertex as in the parent: an AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two on the 9 inputs plus x0 OR x1, true at each of the 12 edge inputs and false at each of 12 listed independent vertex sets, has at least 15 gates.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate OR(x_0, x_1) computes its edge function
